chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Hanan ibn Sadir, from his father, who said:
Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdillah (peace be upon them) said: 'When you see the houses of Mecca, cut off the Talbiyah.'

key_terms.التَّلْبِيَة: The ritual recitation of 'Labbayk' during Hajj

ai.seo_question: When should a pilgrim stop reciting the Talbiyah during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) specifies the precise moment to conclude the Talbiyah upon sighting the visible structures of Mecca, a ruling derived from the Prophet’s practice and recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*. This timing marks the transition from the state of general consecration to the specific rituals of the Hajj, emphasizing the importance of adhering to the physical landmarks designated by the Imams for ritual precision.
